en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of the entrance to a formal institutional complex, likely a military or government facility, with tiled‑roof buildings and trees lining a central street. A uniformed guard stands at the main gate next to striped guardhouses and metal gates. A large flag featuring a swastika in a circular emblem with additional cross motifs flies prominently from a tall flagpole above the entrance. In the background, more multi‑storey buildings with similar architecture and a small clock‑tower structure are visible. A red handwritten catalog number is printed in the upper right corner.
